# IGovernanceRewardsManagerErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/errors/IGovernanceRewardsManagerErrors.sol)

**Title:**
IGovernanceRewardsManagerErrors

Interface defining custom errors for the Governance Rewards Manager


## Errors
### InvalidCaller
Thrown when the caller is not the staking token

Used to restrict certain functions to only be callable by the staking token contract


```solidity
error InvalidCaller();
```

### StakeOnBehalfOfNotSupported
Thrown when the stakeOnBehalfOf function is called (operation not supported)


```solidity
error StakeOnBehalfOfNotSupported();
```

### UnstakeOnBehalfOfNotSupported
Thrown when the UnstakeOnBehalfOfNotSupported function is called (operation not supported)


```solidity
error UnstakeOnBehalfOfNotSupported();
```

### NotDelegated
Thrown when the caller is not delegated


```solidity
error NotDelegated();
```
